intro: Chengdu rewards slow days with spicy food, old lanes and easy trips to mountains and pandas. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro: many lines, English ticket machines, WeChat/Alipay and most international cards accepted.
Metro line 10 links Shuangliu Airport to the centre in about 30-40 min.
Metro line 18 links Tianfu Airport to South Railway Station in about 50 min; ticket to Tianfu Square around ¥11.
Buses cost ¥2 air-conditioned, ¥1 older; exact change or transit card; signs in Chinese only.
Taxis are metered and cheap; add about ¥10 for the airport expressway toll when leaving town.
Ride apps: DiDi works well; walking and shared bikes are good in the flat centre.

jinli.name: Jinli Ancient Street
jinli.price_text: Free to walk; snacks and teahouse extras cost CNY 10–50
jinli.hours: Street open all day · shops roughly 09:00–22:00
jinli.tip: Come after 18:00 when red lanterns light up, and try the snack stalls in the side lanes.

wuhou.name: Wuhou Shrine
wuhou.price_text: ≈ CNY 50 adult; check on the day
wuhou.hours: Roughly 08:00–18:00 (last entry earlier); check on the day
wuhou.tip: Pair it with Jinli next door — the shrine is calm in the morning before tour groups arrive.

panda-base.name: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
panda-base.landmark: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
panda-base.price_text: ≈ CNY 55 adult; check on the day
panda-base.tip: Arrive at opening — pandas eat and play in the morning, then sleep through the heat.

chapanda.name: ChaPanda
chapanda.tip: A local milk-tea chain — order a classic milk tea and ask for less sugar.

oceanarium.name: Cube Oceanarium
oceanarium.tip: Good rainy-day option for families; check feeding-show times before you go.

dicos.name: Dicos
dicos.tip: Fast-food chain for a quick, cheap meal when you need a break from spicy food.

dufu.name: Du Fu Thatched Cottage
dufu.price_text: ≈ CNY 50 adult; check on the day
dufu.tip: A peaceful garden museum about the Tang poet Du Fu — good for a quiet half-day.

happy-valley.name: Happy Valley Chengdu
happy-valley.price_text: ≈ CNY 200–260 day ticket; check on the day
happy-valley.tip: Full-day theme park — go on a weekday and check ride closures online first.

kwafood.name: Kwafood
kwafood.tip: Hotpot chain — order a split pot if you are new to Sichuan spice.

hotpot-dinner.name: Sichuan hotpot dinner
hotpot-dinner.tip: Ask for yuanyang (split) pot and a sesame-oil dip to cool the heat.

kuanzhai.name: Kuanzhai Alley (Kuanzhai Xiangzi)
kuanzhai.price_text: Free to walk; snacks and teahouses extra
kuanzhai.hours: Open all day; liveliest from late afternoon
kuanzhai.tip: Three parallel Qing-era lanes — walk the quiet Wide and Narrow alleys, then the busy Jing lane.

peoples-park.name: People's Park teahouse
peoples-park.price_text: ≈ CNY 20–40 for a pot of tea
peoples-park.tip: Sit in the Heming teahouse, order jasmine tea and watch locals play mahjong.

jinli-market.name: Sichuan snack food street
jinli-market.tip: Try dan dan noodles, mapo tofu and sweet tangyuan in small portions so you can sample more.

sichuan-opera.name: Sichuan opera face-changing show
sichuan-opera.tip: Book ahead for the bianlian face-changing act; arrive early for the teahouse seats.

tianfu-square.name: Tianfu Square
tianfu-square.tip: Central metro hub with the Mao statue — a handy orientation point and people-watching spot.

chunxi-walk.name: Chunxi Road pedestrian shopping walk
chunxi-walk.tip: Busy shopping street with the IFS panda sculpture on the roof — good for an evening stroll.

wenshu.name: Wenshu Monastery
wenshu.tip: Working Buddhist monastery with a vegetarian restaurant and teahouse — a calm break from crowds.

panda-tour.name: Panda base half-day tour
panda-tour.tip: A tour solves the trip out to the panda base — confirm ticket and pickup are included.

qingcheng.name: Qingcheng Mountain day trip
qingcheng.price_text: ≈ CNY 90 entry; transport and cable car extra
qingcheng.tip: Taoist mountain outside the city — a full day; wear good shoes and go early.

jinsha.name: Jinsha Site Museum
jinsha.price_text: ≈ CNY 70 adult; check on the day
jinsha.tip: Ancient Shu gold and jade artifacts — a good indoor pick on a rainy day.

jiuyanqiao.name: Jiuyanqiao bar street evening
jiuyanqiao.tip: Riverside bar strip for a night out — walk the Jinjiang riverbank first at sunset.

jinjiang-walk.name: Jinjiang river walk
jinjiang-walk.tip: Flat riverside path past bridges and teahouses — best at dusk when locals come out.

wenshu-market.name: Local wet market food walk
wenshu-market.tip: Go early with an empty stomach — pick up fresh baozi, pickles and fruit by the bag.

stays.why: Dead centre, on two metro lines; easy walk to museums and the river.
Shopping and food street on the doorstep; good metro links and many hotels.
Old lanes, teahouses and snacks; quieter evenings, central but relaxed.
Near the temple, Jinli Street and the panda-base bus routes; cheaper rooms.

food: Hotpot is the must-do: a divided pot of mild and numbing-spicy broth, dipped in oil and garlic. Expect ¥80–150 per person with drinks.
Try mapo tofu, dan dan noodles and kung pao chicken at small local restaurants; a filling meal is often ¥20–50.
Snack streets: Jinli and Kuanzhai Alley for tourists, or local lanes for cheaper bites. Prices are higher at the famous streets.
Teahouses are part of the day: order jasmine tea, sit for an hour, and watch the city go by. Around ¥20–60 a pot.
Street stalls are fine but busy ones turn over food faster. Drink bottled or boiled water if your stomach is sensitive.
more_time: Add a day for the Leshan Giant Buddha by high-speed train, about 1 hour each way; check times on the day.
Spend a morning at the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding; go early, pandas are active before the heat.
Swap a city day for Qingcheng Mountain and Dujiangyan, an easy day trip by train from the city.
